subject: Marginal of difference of two RVs

messages.author: 2b1000ef6581839c
messages.subject: Marginal of difference of two RVs
parts:
Hi All,

I was wondering if it is possible to calculate the marginal distribution of the difference between two parameters after fitting the model with INLA? 

Specifically this is how I extract the marginal of the random effects:

x1 = model$marginals.random$id_im[1]
x2 = model$marginals.random$id_im[2]

And now I need the marginal of Z = X2 - X1 . What's the best way to do it?

Best regards,
Amin
